The balance sheet shows adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.44) and a very large retained earnings base, but leverage is still fairly high (liabilities are about 78% of assets) and operating returns are modest (EBIT is only about 2.7% of assets). That mix suggests a speculative-to-low investment-grade profile, with enough financial cushion to avoid deeper junk territory but not enough earnings strength for a solid mid-investment-grade assessment.

DECISION: BBB-
